description: Division follows Snowflake's result scale - max(S1, min(S1 + 6, 12)) with S1 the dividend's scale - rounding half away from zero. Integer over integer therefore has SIX fractional digits: 1/3 is 0.333333, not a 10- or 18-digit Java expansion. An exact division keeps its own value, a fractional dividend of scale 1 gives scale 7, and the negative cases round AWAY from zero rather than toward it. DIV0 and DIV0NULL divide the same way and answer zero for their guarded cases. Converted 1:1 from query/DivisionScaleTest (now retired); the Java compared through BigDecimal.compareTo, which ignores trailing zeros, so the converted tests pin the rendered text instead - the scale itself is the claim.
